model_visible.evidence_summary: AWS describes governed access to Claude Platform on AWS from several operating environments, emphasizing identity and environment boundaries.

Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon for long-horizon professional work across software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and defensive cybersecurity; publisher-reported performance claims remain attributed to Google.
AWS pairs generative content with contextual-bandit personalization and measurement, showing a workflow that connects AI-generated variants to explicit decision and evaluation loops.
AWS describes adapting a model to an organization-specific retail moderation policy and validating it for production use.

Perplexity and American Express announced ten pre-built business Skills. Perplexity defines Skills as reusable instruction sets that specify needed information and expected outputs for repeatable work.
OpenAI introduced Dots as always-on agents with their own cloud computer, connected apps and feedback-driven personalization for continuing responsibilities.
